'''August 2001 Cincinnati tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Acme Games, Cincinnati, Ohio on 25 August 2001. [[Matt Scott]] won it. It is known from Alex George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2891">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-cincinnati-oh-8-25-01d2891/ cincinnati-oh-8-25-01], DeckTech (Alex "george3785" George, 25 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-cincinnati-oh-8-25-01d2891/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Acme Games, Cincinnati, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Scott]]
